evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/gui/M matches RuneLite/OpenOSRS net.runelite.client.util.SwingUtil in role and implementation: Swing UI defaults, tooltip policy, LookAndFeel installation, popup-menu helpers, icon-button creation and tray-icon construction.
The exact warning literal 'Unable to add system tray icon' appears in rs/gui/M's tray construction path and in historical RuneLite/OpenOSRS SwingUtil source.
R371 already identifies rs/gui/N as SwingUtilTrayIconMouseListener; rs/gui/M constructs that exact listener when creating the TrayIcon, providing a direct same-family semantic join.

The class is stateless utility infrastructure with static helpers for UIManager defaults, AbstractButton styling/tooltips, icon JButton construction, popup menu entries, LookAndFeel setup and system tray creation; no unrelated client-domain behavior is present.

proposals.note: Exact source-name recovery for RuneLite/OpenOSRS SwingUtil from matching utility surface, literal fingerprint and R371 tray-listener ownership.
